Markets.title: Tonbo Imaging’s Rs 852 crore IPO subscribed 140x. Check GMP, allotment, other details
Markets.summary: Tonbo Imaging's Rs 852 crore initial public offering was subscribed 140 times overall. Qualified institutional buyers led the demand by subscribing 293.56 times their allotted portion.

Markets.title: Global Market: China and Hong Kong shares weaken as stable growth eases stimulus bets
Markets.summary: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks dropped on Tuesday, aligning with a broader regional market retreat. The downturn followed Beijing's decision to keep key lending rates unchanged and stronger-than-expected GDP data that reduced expectations for imminent economic stimulus.

Markets.title: Paras Healthcare secures Rs 652 cr from anchor investors; IPO to open on Oct 21
Markets.summary: Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.5 crore from 39 anchor investors by allotting over 9.4 million shares at Rs 693 each. The company's initial public offering (IPO) is scheduled to open on October 21.

Markets.title: Jio IPO’s GMP rises to 22% as India’s largest ever issue set to open on October 21. Should you subscribe?
Markets.summary: Reliance Jio's initial public offering is priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119 per share and will run from October 21 to October 23. The grey market premium has risen to 22%, indicating a potential listing price of Rs 1,364 per share.

Markets.title: Korea’s KOSPI crashes another 5% as AI rout deepens; AI bellwether down over 40% from peak
Markets.summary: South Korea’s KOSPI index fell 5% amid a deepening artificial intelligence market rout. Chipmakers SK Hynix and Samsung have dropped 35% and 22% from their peaks, while Elice Inc. plunged 32% in its trading debut.

Markets.title: From ₹228 a GB to ₹7.5: How Mukesh Ambani’s Jio rewired India’s internet and is now seeking a ₹10 lakh crore valuation
Markets.summary: Mukesh Ambani's Jio transformed India's internet by dramatically reducing data prices and is now seeking a ₹10 lakh crore valuation. The company is positioning itself for investors as a comprehensive technology platform encompassing 5G, broadband, cloud, and artificial intelligence rather than just a telecom operator.

Geo-Political.title: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says
Geo-Political.summary: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu reported that overnight curfews successfully calmed violence in French cities. He added that officials will determine whether to implement additional curfews for Tuesday night on a case-by-case basis.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian presidential adviser told the BBC that US restrictions on intelligence sharing are causing Ukrainian deaths by delaying warnings about incoming missile attacks. The White House stated that there have been no changes to its intelligence-sharing policies with Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
Geo-Political.summary: Violent anti-government protests in Albania have entered their seventh consecutive day, resulting in nearly 300 injuries. More than half of the injured individuals are police officers as the demonstrations continue without relief.

Geo-Political.title: Canadian tourist found guilty of animal cruelty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
Geo-Political.summary: A Canadian tourist was convicted of animal cruelty after stealing a flamingo from a Las Vegas hotel enclosure. The man claimed he meant no harm and blamed the theft on consuming 30 to 40 beers.

Geo-Political.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
Geo-Political.summary: A spacecraft has launched on a mission to collect 10 grams of dust from a Martian moon. The probe will return the sample to Earth for scientific analysis.

Geo-Political.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
Geo-Political.summary: Self-proclaimed Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of 191 murder charges, nearly all of which were children. He had instructed parents to starve their children to death to meet Jesus.

Data & Insights.title: The changing template of global growth—and what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Despite global economic resilience in 2026, ongoing volatility and unpredictability persist. These unstable worldwide conditions could negatively impact India's future growth trajectory.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's free trade agreement takes effect on October 20, granting Indian exports full duty-free access. The pact aims to increase bilateral trade to about ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
Data & Insights.summary: India has attracted 1.64 lakh crore rupees in investments for 12 semiconductor projects across six states. Gujarat leads this initiative with six approved projects, highlighted by a 91,526 crore rupee fabrication plant from Tata-PSMC.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: No tariff on Indian exports from Oct 20; Textile, pharma, leather exports to gain market access
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 20, the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement will eliminate tariffs on all Indian exports. This tariff removal is expected to boost bilateral trade and improve market access for Indian sectors such as textiles, leather, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture.

Data & Insights.title: Is India’s solar power play facing its Icarus moment?
Data & Insights.summary: India's electricity grid is failing to keep up with the rapid growth of the country's solar power sector. The government must quickly resolve these infrastructure bottlenecks to prevent them from derailing national clean energy goals.

Data & Insights.title: FM Sitharaman flags global capital moving towards US, AI-linked markets as a ‘concern’ for India in 2027
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman warned that global capital shifting toward the US and artificial intelligence markets poses a major risk of investment outflows for India by 2027. She highlighted this trend as a significant concern for the country's financial stability and economic growth.

India.title: IIT Kanpur Invites Startup Founders, Professionals For Youth Challenge 2027
India.summary: IIT Kanpur is inviting startup founders and professionals to participate in the Youth Entrepreneurs Challenge 2027. This national initiative is organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders' Dialogue 2027.

India.title: Priyanka Gandhi At The Wheel As Congress Prepares For UP Alliance Talks
India.summary: Priyanka Gandhi will lead the Congress party's seat-sharing negotiations with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. Party insiders confirmed her pivotal role as preparations begin for the Uttar Pradesh alliance talks.

India.title: How A Cab Driver's Phone Call Helped Cops Trace Tiger Shroff Attack Suspects
India.summary: On Monday, police detained three suspects at a Rajasthan railway station for an alleged assassination attempt on actor Tiger Shroff. A cab driver's phone call ultimately helped law enforcement trace and locate the suspects as they traveled by train.

India.title: IIT Delhi Opens Applications For Executive Course In Managerial Decision Making
India.summary: IIT Delhi is accepting applications for its online Executive Certificate Programme in Managerial Decision Making and Analytics. Interested candidates can apply for the course until November 10, 2026.

India.title: Overseas Job, More Money: What Was Promised To Tiger Shroff Attackers
India.summary: Initial investigations show that the three attackers targeted Tiger Shroff on Sunday evening. In exchange for the attack, they were promised help in securing jobs abroad.

India.title: In RSS Chief's Praise For Captain Smit Machhar, A Reminder Of Hindu Values
India.summary: RSS Chief praised Captain Smit Machchhar for his courage in thwarting a disaster. Captain Machchhar fought off his co-pilot who allegedly tried to crash a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight carrying 174 people.

General.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget, sources say
General.summary: The Chancellor has decided against raising Capital Gains Tax in the upcoming Budget despite pressure from senior Labour figures. Critics had warned that equalising the tax with income tax would cause wealthy individuals to leave the country.

General.title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
General.summary: Andy Burnham has vowed to end expensive parking charges and harsh penalties for motorists on private land. New rules are being introduced to protect drivers from unfair fines.
